title: Quiet private room on Glenrock, 8 min walk to Bruin Walk
address: Glenrock Ave, Westwood, CA
description: Eight-minute walk to Bruin Walk, so you won't need a parking permit. Two grad students and a senior live here, and the house goes quiet after Isha so people can study.

title: Sisters' shared room on Kelton, bike to Royce in 6
address: Kelton Ave, Westwood, CA
description: Two sisters to a room in a sunny 2-bed. Royce Hall is a six-minute bike ride. In Ramadan we do iftar together most nights and take turns cooking.

title: Calm 2-bed on Midvale with a balcony and a cat
address: Midvale Ave, Westwood, CA
description: It's me (third-year nursing) plus Zaytoon, a very lazy cat. Small balcony that gets afternoon sun. Campus is a 15-minute walk, or hop on the Big Blue Bus up Westwood Blvd.

title: Brothers' house on Veteran, Fajr crew included
address: Veteran Ave, Westwood, CA
description: Five brothers, three bedrooms. There's always someone awake for Fajr, and we walk up to the campus musalla together for Jumu'ah. Open spot is a shared bed in the big room.

title: 4th room open in an engineers' house on Malcolm
address: Malcolm Ave, Westwood, CA
description: Three EE and CS majors looking for a fourth. One living room wall is a whiteboard, which tells you how weeknights go. Boelter Hall is a 12-minute walk.

title: Selby Ave room, brothers upstairs and sisters downstairs
address: Selby Ave, Westwood, CA
description: Each floor has its own bathroom. We share the kitchen, which isn't strictly halal, but every shelf and pan is labeled. About a 20-minute walk, or five on a scooter.

title: Shared room for a sister off Ohio Ave
address: Ohio Ave, Westwood, CA
description: There's a coffee shop around the corner that stays open late, so finals week is covered. On Sundays someone does a halal grocery run on Westwood Blvd. The bus gets you to campus in about 10 minutes.

title: Own room and own bathroom on Wellworth
address: Wellworth Ave, Westwood, CA
description: Two beds and two baths, so nobody waits in line before an 8am. I'm looking for a tidy brother who doesn't mind me reciting Quran after Fajr. Ten-minute walk to campus.

title: Brentwood sisters' apartment with a dog-friendly yard
address: Barrington Ave, Brentwood, CA
description: You'd share a room with one sister. Our third roommate has a sleepy senior dog. Big Blue Bus to campus takes about 15 minutes, and on Ramadan weekends we open our fast together.

title: Sawtelle room in a mixed grad-student house
address: Brockton Ave, Sawtelle, CA
description: Two PhD students (a brother and a sister) with separate wings. The Sawtelle noodle shops are down the block for after-lab dinners. It's a 15-minute bike ride up to campus.

title: Six brothers, one big kitchen on Corinth
address: Corinth Ave, Sawtelle, CA
description: Probably the cheapest way to live near UCLA: a shared room in a 3-bed with six brothers. We meal-prep in bulk on Sundays and split the grocery bill. Iftar here is a whole event.

title: Palms 2-bed for a sister, kitchen not halal-only
address: Overland Ave, Palms, CA
description: My roommate is Muslim but sometimes cooks non-halal, so we keep separate pans and shelves. The Culver CityBus 6 runs straight up to campus in about 20 minutes.

title: Brothers' 4-bed on 27th, walk to Jumu'ah
address: W 27th St, North University Park, Los Angeles, CA
description: Leavey Library is a ten-minute walk. On Fridays we walk to Masjid Umar on Exposition for Jumu'ah. We need a fourth who can live with a few early Fajr alarms.

title: Sisters' shared room on Menlo, gated building
address: Menlo Ave, University Park, Los Angeles, CA
description: Gated entry with a night shuttle stop at the corner, which our parents liked a lot. You'd share with a dental student who's out the door by 7.

title: Portland St room with a backyard herb garden
address: Portland St, University Park, Los Angeles, CA
description: We grow mint and cilantro out back, so chai and chutney are always homemade. The kitchen is halal and there's one friendly rabbit. Seven-minute bike to campus.

title: Severance St duplex, separate entrances
address: Severance St, North University Park, Los Angeles, CA
description: Old Craftsman split in two, with a brother on one side and a sister on the other, each with their own door. The shared kitchen isn't halal-only. About a 15-minute walk to class.

title: Top bunk in a five-brother house on Orchard
address: Orchard Ave, North University Park, Los Angeles, CA
description: Loud on game nights and dead silent during finals. We pool money for a monthly halal meat run to Koreatown. The open spot is the top bunk in the biggest room.

title: Study-first sisters' house on Raymond
address: Raymond Ave, University Park, Los Angeles, CA
description: All three of us are pre-med, so the dining table basically doubles as a library. The walk to campus is ten minutes on well-lit streets.

title: Budlong shared room by Exposition Park
address: Budlong Ave, Exposition Park, Los Angeles, CA
description: After Fajr we run laps around the Rose Garden in Expo Park. There's a cat in the house. It's a 12-minute walk to campus.

title: Normandie room, short walk to the E Line
address: Normandie Ave, University Park, Los Angeles, CA
description: The Expo/Vermont station is a short walk, which is handy for internships downtown. Brothers only, halal kitchen, and someone usually makes biryani on Sundays.

title: Newer 2-bed on 37th with in-unit laundry
address: W 37th St, Exposition Park, Los Angeles, CA
description: Built a few years ago: in-unit laundry and your own bathroom. Masjid Umar is close enough to walk to for Taraweeh in Ramadan.

title: Hoover St house for six brothers
address: Hoover St, North University Park, Los Angeles, CA
description: Big old house with AC that actually works in September. Every other Thursday we host the MSA brothers' halaqa in the living room.

title: Budget room on 41st in a mixed grad house
address: W 41st St, Vermont Square, Los Angeles, CA
description: Cheapest private room this close to USC we've found. Two grad students (a brother and a sister) plus a dog. The kitchen is shared and not halal-only. 15-minute bike up Vermont.

title: Catalina St shared room for a sister
address: S Catalina St, University Park, Los Angeles, CA
description: Quiet street. You'd share with a social work junior. When we're both home we pray Maghrib together. Twelve-minute walk to campus.

title: Linden St room, a short walk from the Islamic Center
address: Linden St, University, Riverside, CA
description: The Islamic Center of Riverside is just down Linden, so Fajr in jamaah is actually doable. Campus is a ten-minute walk.

title: Shared room on Blaine for under $500
address: Blaine St, University, Riverside, CA
description: Two sisters per room. The bus stop on Blaine gets you to the Bell Tower in about five minutes, and the halal market on University Ave is close by.

title: Iowa Ave sisters' house with a tabby
address: Iowa Ave, University, Riverside, CA
description: The tabby's name is Kunafa and she will sit on your laptop. We have a big backyard and a halal kitchen, and campus is a 12-minute bike ride.

title: Hillside 2-bed on Big Springs, walk down to class
address: Big Springs Rd, Box Springs, Riverside, CA
description: Right up against the Box Springs hills, and we hike the C trail on weekends. It's a ten-minute walk down to class. Own bathroom.

title: Watkins Dr shared room, cheapest near UCR
address: Watkins Dr, Box Springs, Riverside, CA
description: Five brothers, mostly transfers from community college like you probably are. Shared room for $450. We cook dal and rice in big batches and walk to campus in 12 minutes.

title: Canyon Crest room with separate floors
address: Canyon Crest Dr, Canyon Crest, Riverside, CA
description: Brothers sleep upstairs and sisters downstairs. The kitchen is shared and not halal-only. There's a grocery store in walking distance, and campus is about 15 minutes by bike.

title: Valencia Hill townhouse for four sisters
address: Valencia Hill Dr, Canyon Crest, Riverside, CA
description: Townhouse complex with a pool we actually use in the heat. Four sisters, own rooms. In Ramadan we set up iftar on the patio and invite the MSA sisters.

title: Chicago Ave shared room, 3 brothers
address: Chicago Ave, Eastside, Riverside, CA
description: Small but cheap. You'd share a room with a second-year bio major. RTA bus to campus is about ten minutes, or bike it in eight.

title: Mt Vernon 2-bed with a sister and her bunny
address: Mt Vernon Ave, University, Riverside, CA
description: I'm a fourth-year with a very calm bunny. I'm up for Fajr and then off to the library early, so the apartment stays quiet in the mornings.

title: Ottawa Ave room in a mixed house, own lock
address: Ottawa Ave, University, Riverside, CA
description: Every bedroom has its own lock. Two grad students live here now, a brother and a sister. The kitchen isn't halal-only. Eight-minute walk to campus.

title: MLK Blvd sisters' apartment, two baths
address: Martin Luther King Blvd, Canyon Crest, Riverside, CA
description: Two shared rooms, each with its own bathroom, which helps a lot during wudu traffic. The bus to campus runs right outside.

title: Spruce St house with a dog and a grill
address: Spruce St, Eastside, Riverside, CA
description: Three brothers and a golden retriever. We grill halal kebabs out back most weekends. Fifteen minutes to campus by bike.

title: Regents Rd room, SuperLoop to campus
address: Regents Rd, UTC, San Diego, CA
description: The SuperLoop bus stops at the corner and has you at Geisel in about ten minutes. Three brothers in a quiet complex. We drive to Clairemont for halal groceries every couple of weeks.

title: Lebon Dr shared room for sisters
address: Lebon Dr, UTC, San Diego, CA
description: Two sisters per room in a 2-bed, 2-bath. The trolley at UTC is a five-minute walk, and the mall food court has a halal spot for nights nobody cooks.

title: Nobel Dr 2-bed, own bathroom, near the trolley
address: Nobel Dr, UTC, San Diego, CA
description: I'm a bioengineering grad student and I'm in lab most days. You'd get your own bathroom. The Blue Line to campus takes two stops.

title: Genesee Ave shared room, five brothers
address: Genesee Ave, UTC, San Diego, CA
description: Cheapest way we know to live near UCSD. Five brothers, and we carpool to the masjid in Clairemont on Fridays. It's a shared room with a desk each.

title: Palmilla Dr 4-bed with a pool and a cat
address: Palmilla Dr, UTC, San Diego, CA
description: The complex pool is great after a long lab. There's one cat. Four brothers, all in Warren or Sixth. It's a 15-minute bike to campus, mostly downhill.

title: Charmant Dr room in a mixed grad apartment
address: Charmant Dr, UTC, San Diego, CA
description: Three grad students, each in their own room, and the sisters have their own bathroom. The kitchen isn't halal-only, so bring your own pans. Shuttle to campus every 15 minutes.

title: Costa Verde shared room, sisters only
address: Costa Verde Blvd, UTC, San Diego, CA
description: Gym and study room in the building. You'd share a room with a sister in Revelle. We wake each other up for suhoor in Ramadan.

title: Villa La Jolla 2-bed, walk to Price Center
address: Villa La Jolla Dr, La Jolla, CA
description: Price Center is a 15-minute walk. I'm a quiet third-year, usually at the library until Isha. It's one bathroom, but our schedules don't overlap.

title: La Jolla Scenic townhouse room for a sister
address: La Jolla Scenic Dr N, La Jolla, CA
description: Close enough to walk to Muir. Three sisters in a townhouse with a little garden where we pray Asr when the weather's nice, which is always.

title: Shared room near the Shores, sunset walks
address: Avenida de la Playa, La Jolla Shores, CA
description: Four brothers, two blocks from the beach. We pray Maghrib on the sand when we can. You'll want a bike for the hill up to campus, about 15 minutes.

title: El Paseo Grande cottage, mixed, separate entrances
address: El Paseo Grande, La Jolla Shores, CA
description: Main house plus a back cottage with its own door. The current tenant is a sister in the main house. Shared kitchen, not halal-only. Close to Scripps Pier.

title: Governor Dr room for a sister, quiet street
address: Governor Dr, University City, San Diego, CA
description: A single-story house on a quiet street with lots of families. The bus to campus takes about 20 minutes. Our halal kitchen is stocked from the markets in Clairemont.

title: Turtle Rock 4-bed, brothers, big backyard
address: Turtle Rock Dr, Turtle Rock, Irvine, CA
description: Four brothers in a house with a real backyard. We drive to the Islamic Center of Irvine for Jumu'ah, about ten minutes. Bike to campus in 15.

title: Sandburg Way shared room for sisters
address: Sandburg Way, Turtle Rock, Irvine, CA
description: Two sisters per room in a quiet townhouse. The Anteater Express shuttle stop is a short walk. In Ramadan we host iftar for the MSA sisters on Fridays.

title: Culver Dr room with a sister and two cats
address: Culver Dr, University Park, Irvine, CA
description: Two cats, two sisters, one open room. The Mason Park trail is behind us for walks after Asr. Campus is a 15-minute bike along the San Diego Creek path.

title: Harvard Ave shared room, five brothers
address: Harvard Ave, University Park, Irvine, CA
description: Mostly engineering transfers. We have a group chat just for Fajr wake-ups. Shared room, $800, and the bus is right outside.

title: Own bathroom in a 2-bed near Rancho San Joaquin
address: University Dr, Rancho San Joaquin, Irvine, CA
description: Two-bed, two-bath, a ten-minute walk to Aldrich Park. I'm a law student, so it's quiet here. There's a halal grill nearby for nights neither of us cooks.

title: Campus Dr room in a mixed apartment, own lock
address: Campus Dr, Irvine, CA
description: Across from campus, so you can walk to an 8am in ten minutes. A brother and a sister live here now, each with their own bathroom. The kitchen isn't halal-only.

title: Bonita Canyon shared room, dog-friendly
address: Bonita Canyon Dr, Turtle Rock, Irvine, CA
description: Shared room with a nursing student. Our third roommate has a small, quiet dog. The bike trail gets you to campus in about 12 minutes.

title: Eastbluff room with a view of the Back Bay
address: Eastbluff Dr, Eastbluff, Newport Beach, CA
description: We run the Back Bay loop after Fajr. Three brothers and a lazy cat. It's a 15-minute bike to campus across Jamboree.

title: Vista del Oro 2-bed for a sister
address: Vista del Oro, Eastbluff, Newport Beach, CA
description: I'm a public health senior who's up early for Fajr and asleep by 11. Quiet complex with lots of trees. About a 20-minute bike to campus.

title: Ford Rd shared room, four brothers
address: Ford Rd, Bonita Canyon, Newport Beach, CA
description: Two brothers per room, each room with its own bathroom. Someone always has the car for Costco and halal meat runs. Campus is a 15-minute bike.

title: Shady Canyon townhouse, mixed grad students
address: Shady Canyon Dr, Turtle Rock, Irvine, CA
description: Three PhD students in a townhouse, and the sisters' room has its own bathroom. The shared kitchen isn't halal-only. It's quiet, near the hiking trails, and 20 minutes to campus by bike.

title: Bison Ave sisters' apartment by the bike path
address: Bison Ave, Newport Beach, CA
description: The bike path takes you straight to campus in ten minutes. Three sisters, a halal kitchen, and Sunday brunch is a house rule.

title: Olive Dr room, bike under the tracks to class
address: Olive Dr, Davis, CA
description: The Richards underpass puts you on campus in about eight minutes by bike. Three brothers, and we take turns making chai after Fajr before the first lecture.

title: Downtown Davis shared room above the bookstore block
address: E St, Downtown, Davis, CA
description: Two sisters to a room, right by the Saturday farmers market. The Unitrans bus stops a block away, or it's a ten-minute bike to the Quad.

title: B St duplex for a sister, cat on site
address: B St, Downtown, Davis, CA
description: I'm a vet med student with a very social cat named Basbousa. The duplex is across the street from campus, so you can walk to an 8am in five minutes.

title: Old North Davis house, separate floors
address: F St, Old North Davis, Davis, CA
description: Brothers upstairs, a sister downstairs with her own bathroom. The kitchen is shared and not halal-only. Big shady yard, and a 12-minute bike to campus.

title: Russell Blvd room, two minutes from the Silo
address: Russell Blvd, Central Davis, Davis, CA
description: Four brothers, all ag and engineering majors. The MSA prayer room is a short walk across Russell, which makes Dhuhr between classes easy.

title: Sycamore Ln shared room, quiet complex
address: Sycamore Ln, Central Davis, Davis, CA
description: Quiet hours are actually enforced here, which is why we picked it. You'd share with a third-year in psych. In Ramadan we break our fast together on the balcony.

title: North Davis brothers' house near the greenbelt
address: Anderson Rd, North Davis, Davis, CA
description: Five brothers and a backyard tortoise. The greenbelt bike path takes you to campus in ten minutes without crossing a big road.

title: West Davis room in a grad-student house
address: Arlington Blvd, West Davis, Davis, CA
description: Two PhD students, a brother and a sister, each with their own wing. The kitchen isn't halal-only, but there's a halal shelf and separate pans. Fifteen minutes by bike.

title: Lake Blvd 2-bed for a sister
address: Lake Blvd, West Davis, Davis, CA
description: Own bathroom and a desk by the window. I'm a nutrition senior who meal-preps on Sundays, so the fridge is always full. The Unitrans line runs to the MU in about 15 minutes.

title: Oak Ave room, walk to the ARC
address: Oak Ave, Central Davis, Davis, CA
description: The gym is a five-minute walk and so is the Quad. Three brothers who keep the house clean and wake each other up for suhoor in Ramadan.

title: College Terrace room, walk to the Oval
address: Wellesley St, College Terrace, Palo Alto, CA
description: Fifteen-minute walk to the Oval, or five by bike. Three brothers, mostly CS. We drive together to the masjid in Santa Clara for Jumu'ah when classes allow.

title: Shared room on Stanford Ave, steps from Escondido
address: Stanford Ave, College Terrace, Palo Alto, CA
description: About the cheapest way to live this close to campus. Two sisters per room, and Escondido Village is just across the street. We do iftar with the Muslim grad students in Ramadan.

title: Professorville cottage room for a sister
address: Waverley St, Professorville, Palo Alto, CA
description: Small cottage behind an old shingle house, with a garden and a very calm dog. The Marguerite shuttle from downtown gets you to campus in about ten minutes.

title: Downtown Palo Alto room in a mixed grad flat
address: Bryant St, Downtown North, Palo Alto, CA
description: A brother and a sister in the GSB and the med school, each with their own bathroom. The kitchen is shared and not halal-only. Caltrain and the Marguerite are both a short walk.

title: Evergreen Park shared room, four brothers
address: Park Blvd, Evergreen Park, Palo Alto, CA
description: Two brothers per room, a block from California Ave cafes for late study sessions. Someone's always up for Fajr, and it's a 12-minute bike to the engineering quad.

title: Menlo Park room on Middle Ave, bike path to campus
address: Middle Ave, Menlo Park, CA
description: Four brothers and a cat in a ranch house with a big kitchen. The Middle Ave bike bridge drops you onto campus in ten minutes. We grill on weekends, halal only.

title: Santa Cruz Ave apartment for two sisters
address: Santa Cruz Ave, Menlo Park, CA
description: Own bathroom, and the downtown Menlo Park shops are below us. I'm a bioengineering PhD student, out by 8 and home by Maghrib. Twenty minutes to campus by bike.

title: Oak Grove Ave shared room, Caltrain close by
address: Oak Grove Ave, Menlo Park, CA
description: Two shared rooms, each with its own bathroom. Menlo Park Caltrain is a few minutes away for weekend trips to the halal markets in Fremont.

title: East Palo Alto room, lower rent, longer ride
address: Euclid Ave, East Palo Alto, CA
description: The lowest rent we've found for a private room near Stanford. The trade-off is a 25-minute bike ride to campus. Three brothers and a friendly dog.

title: Midtown Palo Alto house, mixed, separate entrances
address: Colorado Ave, Midtown, Palo Alto, CA
description: Main house plus a converted garage unit with its own door. A sister lives in the main house now. The shared kitchen isn't halal-only. Bryant St bike boulevard to campus in 15 minutes.
